news.headline: Nine targets for Josh Downs after Pierce departure
news.summary: Downs became Daniel Jones' clear top target (7-of-9 targets, 72 yards) after Colts WR1 Alec Pierce re-aggravated his heel and is headed to injured reserve for at least four weeks.

news.headline: Wilson goes 2/18, faces 2 DPI calls, 2 overthrows
news.summary: Wilson's quiet Week 2 (2 catches/18 yards) was more about drawn pass-interference calls and QB overthrows than a lost role — he's still Jacoby Brissett's most-targeted receiver at 14 targets over two games.

news.headline: Flowers (hammy) has 'good shot' to play vs. DAL
news.summary: Ravens HC Jesse Minter said Flowers has a good shot to play in Week 3 after returning to practice Friday as a limited participant on his hamstring.

news.headline: Commanders still await Daniels timeline, will start Mariota vs. Seahawks
news.summary: Jayden Daniels (dislocated elbow) has no firm return timeline and Marcus Mariota is confirmed as Washington's Week 3 starter, a real downgrade risk to Diggs' efficiency.

news.headline: Woody Marks active in receiving game Sunday
news.summary: Marks caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards in relief work behind David Montgomery, giving him standalone flex appeal in deeper PPR formats but no change for this roster.

news.headline: Devaughn Vele goes for 64 yards in win over Ravens
news.summary: Vele has solidified as the Saints' clear WR2 with Jordyn Tyson on IR, posting 12 targets for 133 yards and a touchdown through two games.

news.headline: Tyler Shough executes late comeback win in Week 2
news.summary: Shough threw for 252 yards and a touchdown in a Week 2 comeback win over Baltimore, putting him at 662 yards and 4 TDs through two games as New Orleans' starter.

news.headline: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) inactive for MNF vs. Giants
news.summary: Nacua was ruled out for Week 2 with a hip/groin issue that McVay called mild soreness, not the more serious psoas injury from earlier in the year; no Week 3 designation yet.

news.headline: Okonkwo (hamstring) not practicing on Wednesday
news.summary: Okonkwo remained sidelined with a hamstring injury and was ruled out for Week 2; no Week 3 practice report has posted yet, and the Mariota-for-Daniels QB downgrade further caps his outlook if he does play.

news.headline: Saints' Travis Etienne: Limited volume in Baltimore
news.summary: Alvin Kamara out-touched Etienne 14-8 in his return from a MCL sprain, winning nearly all of the passing-down and red-zone work in Week 2.

news.headline: Fantasy Football Impact: Saquon Barkley's Injury Could Open The Door For Tank Bigsby To Emerge
news.summary: Barkley left Week 2 with a stinger after just 12 snaps and is undergoing an MRI with results not yet public; Bigsby filled in well (13 carries, 33 yards, TD) and has real standalone value if Barkley is limited.

news.headline: Sources: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have sprained MCL
news.summary: Dart left Monday's loss to the Rams with a believed MCL sprain (X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday); backup Jameis Winston struggled in relief but still found Likely five times on a team-high 69% snap share.

news.headline: Quinshon Judkins stuck in neutral in Week 2
news.summary: Judkins played 39 snaps to backup Raheim Sanders' 11, a wider gap than Week 1, resolving the committee question even though his rushing efficiency was modest (12 carries/21 yards).

news.headline: Fantasy Football Takeaways: Parker Washington Leads Week 3 Utilization Report
news.summary: Washington ranks as fantasy's WR11 through two weeks with a 38% target share (2nd in the NFL) and climbed to 90% route participation in Week 2.

news.headline: Injury Report: Week 3 vs 49ers
news.summary: Arizona is banged up ahead of facing San Francisco's defense — CB Will Johnson (groin) doubtful and CB Max Melton (knee) questionable — while the 49ers' front seven is fully healthy.

news.headline: Corum goes for 92 scoreless yards in Rams win
news.summary: Corum matched Kyren Williams' workload almost exactly (12 carries/79 yards plus a catch) in Week 2, remaining a touchdown-dependent bench piece in an even committee.
